items.title: Call to cancel/reschedule delivery appointment
items.quote: Passt Ihnen der Tag nicht, rufen Sie uns spätestens drei Werktage vorher an.
items.computation: Appointment day is Saturday, 12.12.2026. 'Drei Werktage vorher' (at least three working days before) counted backwards from the appointment day, excluding the appointment day itself: Fri 11.12. = Werktag 1, Thu 10.12. = Werktag 2, Wed 09.12. = Werktag 3. No weekend days or NW public holidays fall in this window, so the counting is unambiguous. The call must therefore reach the company no later than Wednesday, 09.12.2026.
